cause: The app published its snapshot before content.json completed, but the back-to-book link was initialized only by the later teaching UI render. A cold direct waves entry could return to the static default Chinese book without its chapter.
publicEvidence: Expected ?lang=en#wave-lab; observed ?lang=zh with content.json still pending. Canonical bytes of all 146 MP3s and ten critical files had already matched release #35.
fix: Initialize the already validated return route immediately after URL parsing, independent of content loading. Retain the existing later render update for language switches.

regression.baseline: FAIL: Chinese default instead of English/wave-lab while the teaching fetch is deliberately held.
regression.fixed: PASS: English/waves, Chinese/fault and unknown-source validation before teaching content loads; real back-link navigation preserves the language and correct book entry.

publicAudioProvenanceBoundary: Warm native media can be fulfilled by a legitimate browser HTTP cache. The independent public verification disables only its own browser HTTP cache to require actual Cache Storage provenance; user caches are never cleared.
externalAcceptance: Pending this follow-up PR CI, Pages and public recheck.
